facts.fact: Reuters reports that South Africa's communications minister set up a seven-member expert panel to review the draft national AI policy released in April 2026 and withdrawn over fictitious references, with a revised policy due to go to Cabinet by November 2026.

facts.fact: Reuters reports that South Africa's draft national AI policy was released in April 2026 for public comment, before being withdrawn, and that the target date for a revised draft for public comment is January 2027, per the department's acting deputy director-general.
